cards.subject: Tesla · xAI
cards.author: divyanshekha
cards.name: divyanshishekhawat
cards.text: Hey @elonmusk, greetings from Rajasthan, India! Had 2 futuristic business concepts built on First Principles for your ecosystem: (1.)Tesla Compute Marketplace: Monetize parked Tesla FSD chips at night to form a decentralized cloud network for training @xai Grok.

cards.subject: FSD · Grok
cards.author: michaelxbloch
cards.name: Michael Bloch
cards.text: No one alive has done more for human productivity than @elonmusk. Right now I'm sitting in my Tesla. I haven't touched the wheel since I got in. FSD is driving me home. I'm having a voice discussion with Grok about quantum tech as it drives me. It’s seamless and near zero

cards.subject: Grok in the car
cards.author: afrikha44
cards.name: Afrikha
cards.text: Tesla's Summer Update quietly handed Grok real control of the car: voice commands reach deeper vehicle functions in 2026.26.6.5, now merged with FSD v14.3.8. The xAI-Tesla integration is becoming a product, not a demo.

cards.subject: Grok Build
cards.author: Toshogu
cards.name: Toshogu | AI
cards.text: xAI makes Grok Build available to all paying Grok and X subscribers. The feature turns a typed sentence into a working app, game, or website, each with its own web address, on web, iPhone, and Android.

cards.subject: Grok Bot · Tesla
cards.author: TeslaJedi
cards.name: Aaron
cards.text: Grok Bot is coming to Teslas. Every HW4/AI5 car already has a supercomputer sitting there for FSD — most of it idle when parked or on charge. If owners can offload some Grok inference onto that hardware, do we get a block of free tokens for…

cards.subject: Grok Bot day
cards.author: 1andypatterson
cards.name: Andy Patterson
cards.text: I’m not a content creator or a high-profile exec. I’m a dad of 7 running a small family-owned business the best I can every day. But today… today was different. Today my Grok Bot @bot worked all day for me and got more done than I ever could have all while my @Tesla on FSD

cards.subject: Morning brief
cards.author: press
cards.name: PRESS
cards.text: Subjects to thicken later: FSD parking/micro-nav friction · Grok Build for all paid · Tesla idle-compute ideas · household FSD/Grok plans.

cards.subject: FSD · Unpark
cards.author: lotnotes
cards.name: Lot Notes
cards.text: FSD can drive you home. Getting out of a tight Chicago lot still asks for a hand. Micro-nav and unpark are the next newspaper subjects — not a status tile.

cards.subject: Cabin Grok
cards.author: cabinline
cards.name: Cabin Line
cards.text: Voice in the cabin is the product now. Climate, seat, nav, and a Grok thread while FSD holds the lane. The car is a room. The room has a desk.

cards.subject: Idle compute
cards.author: nightpack
cards.name: Night Pack
cards.text: Parked HW4 is a supercomputer on a charger. Most of it idle. If Grok inference can sit on that silicon at night, the driveway is a rack.

cards.subject: Grok Build desk
cards.author: desknote
cards.name: Desk Note
cards.text: Typed sentence → app with a URL. Grok Build on paid is a workshop, not a demo reel. The wall should carry the workshop, not a launch banner.

cards.subject: Evening brief
cards.author: press
cards.name: PRESS
cards.text: Keep the grid straight. Fill the glass. Subjects: unpark friction · cabin voice · driveway inference · Grok Build workshop · household FSD plans.

cards.subject: Robotaxi watch
cards.author: curbside
cards.name: Curbside
cards.text: Robotaxi talk belongs on PRESS as a subject, not a countdown. Watch unsupervised miles, parking, and the last fifty feet to the curb.

cards.subject: FSD v14
cards.author: lanekeep
cards.name: Lane Keep
cards.text: v14.3 is the one in the car tonight. Smooth on the arterial. Still a human for the garage door and the last turn into the stall.

cards.subject: xAI · train
cards.author: rackrow
cards.name: Rack Row
cards.text: Training is a Memphis story. Inference may become a driveway story. PRESS keeps both on the same wall so the room can see the split.

cards.subject: Household FSD
cards.author: kitchenpad
cards.name: Kitchen Pad
cards.text: Two cars, one Grok, a school run and a grocery loop. The household plan is the real product. The wall should make that glanceable.
